column5: A totally imaginary quadratic extension E of a totally real number field E+; complex conjugation is the nontrivial automorphism of E/E+ and commutes with every complex embedding.
A choice, for a CM field E, of one complex embedding from each pair of conjugate embeddings; equivalently an embedding for each infinite place.
column6: CM field; Infinite place of a number field

column1: Infinite place of a number field
column5: An archimedean place of a number field: an equivalence class of complex embeddings under complex conjugation. For E = K(zeta_{q1}) the infinite places are identified with (Z/q1)^x.
column6: Number field; Place of a global field

column5: The least n >= 1 with g^n = 1, or 0 (infinite) if there is none.

The polynomial representation of GL_n attached to a Young diagram, realised with integral structure as the span of products of minors (one minor of size h for each column of height h) of a generic matrix; here taken as a product over the infinite places, with basis given by products of minors with integer coefficients.
A finite left-justified array of boxes with weakly decreasing row lengths; here described by the numbers kappa(h) of columns of each height h.
For a number field E, the inverse of the codifferent {x : Tr(x O_E) in Z}; an integral ideal of O_E.
column6: Codifferent of a number field; Ring of integers

column5: A homomorphism from a group G to the invertible linear maps of a vector space V; extends to an algebra map from the group algebra.
The algebra C[G] of finite formal combinations of group elements.
dim ker f + dim im f = dim V for an endomorphism (linear map) of a finite-dimensional space.

column1: Finite adele ring of a number field
column5: The restricted product of the completions E_v at the finite places v with respect to the rings of integers O_v; its integral elements are the product of the O_v.
column6: Number field; Completion at a place; Restricted product

column5: The quotient of a local ring by its maximal ideal; for a prime w of a number field, O_E/w.

column1: Class of a hermitian lattice in a genus
column5: For a definite unitary group G over a number field with finite adelic points G_f, rational points Gamma and an open compact subgroup K, the classes are the double cosets Gamma\G_f/K; for K the stabiliser of a lattice L they are the isometry classes of lattices in the genus of L. Their number is finite.
column6: Unitary group of a hermitian space; Finite adele ring of a number field; Hermitian lattice

column1: Unitary group of a hermitian space
column5: For a hermitian space (V,h) over a CM field E, the group of E-linear automorphisms preserving h, as an algebraic group over E+; here V = E^n with h = sum x_i conj(x_i), and its finite adelic points G_f.

A finite-dimensional vector space over a field with involution with a nondegenerate sesquilinear form h satisfying h(y,x) = conj(h(x,y)); definite if h(x,x) is totally positive for x nonzero at every real place.
For an integer (or integral element) G, the subgroup of the integral points K_0 of the finite adelic group consisting of the elements congruent to 1 modulo G.
column6: Finite adele ring of a number field

column5: (Gross) For a group G compact at infinity, a function on G(A_f) with values in an algebraic representation W, equivariant under G(Q) on the left and invariant under an open compact subgroup on the right. Here: forms of weight (kappa,e) on a definite unitary group.
column6: Unitary group of a hermitian space; Weyl module; Finite adele ring of a number field

column5: Lambda(n) = log p if n = p^e with p prime and e >= 1, and 0 otherwise.

For an odd prime d and an integer n: 0 if d divides n, 1 if n is a nonzero square mod d, -1 otherwise. Here chi_K(n) = (n/d), the quadratic character of K = Q(sqrt(-d)) for d = 3 mod 4: a prime p splits, is inert, or ramifies in K according as chi_K(p) = 1, -1, 0.
Sum_{1 <= c <= y} 1/c <= 1 + log y for real y >= 1.
For a positive semidefinite hermitian form: |u-v|^2 + |u+v|^2 = 2|u|^2 + 2|v|^2.
C_p: the completion of an algebraic closure of Q_p; algebraically closed and complete; the source fixes for each p embeddings iota: C -> C_p (class PadicPlace).
column6: p-adic field; Completion of a valued field; Algebraic closure

column5: For odd x and even n, v_2(x^n - 1) = v_2(x-1) + v_2(x+1) + v_2(n) - 1; in the form used: if x^o = 1 mod 2^(s+1) with o > 0 then 2^s divides (x-1)o or (x+1)o.

column1: Decomposition of primes in a cyclotomic extension
column5: For p not dividing n, p is unramified in Q(zeta_n) and its residue degree is the order of p in (Z/n)^x; the Frobenius is the class of p. Used for E = K(zeta_{q1}) with K imaginary quadratic and p inert in K.
column6: Cyclotomic field; Frobenius element; Residue degree

column1: Hecke operator at a split prime
column5: For a unitary group and a prime l of E with l different from its conjugate, the group at {l, conj l} is GL_n(E_l); the Hecke operator of index r is the double coset operator of diag(varpi,..) types summed as in the source (New.heckeSplit), acting on forms spherical at l.
column6: Unitary group of a hermitian space; Hecke algebra; Double coset operator

column5: For GL_k over a local ring W with maximal ideal m and a block decomposition k = r + (k-r): the subgroup of GL_k(W) of matrices whose reduction modulo m is block upper/lower triangular; here: entries (i,j) with i < r <= j lie in m.

For a number field and finitely many places, the diagonal image of the field (or of the rational points of a suitable group) is dense in the product of the completions; used above p for the unitary group to adjust a point by a rational one so that it becomes integral.
column6: Place of a global field; Completion at a place

column5: The matrix of the map induced by a k x k matrix on homogeneous polynomials (monomials) of degree a in k variables; multiplicative in the matrix.
The matrix of the tensor product of linear maps; here over a finite family of factors.
In the form used: log n! <= n log n - n + 1 + (log n)/2 for n >= 1; the sequence n!/(sqrt(2n) (n/e)^n) is decreasing.

The representation of a dual pair (here unitary groups U(X) x U(X') acting on Hom(X,X') over the adeles, with a splitting character) on Schwartz functions, through the Heisenberg group; its finite part contains the vacuum vector (indicator of the integral lattice) and its Heisenberg translates.
column6: Heisenberg group; Unitary group of a hermitian space; Schwartz-Bruhat function

column5: For a symplectic (or hermitian) space W with additive character psi: W x center with the law (w,z)(w',z') = (w+w', z z' psi(<w,w'>/2)); its translations act on Schwartz functions and compose with a phase given by the pairing.

For a dual pair (G,G') and a Schwartz datum Phi, the map sending an automorphic form f on G to the form g' -> integral (here: finite class sum) of the theta kernel theta_Phi(g,g') against f(g). For definite unitary groups the lift of algebraic modular forms is a finite sum over classes weighted by the inverse orders of automorphism groups.
column6: Weil representation; Algebraic modular form; Theta series

column5: For a locally profinite group G and open compact K: the convolution algebra of compactly supported K-biinvariant functions; the characteristic function of a double coset KgK acts on K-fixed vectors by the sum over the right cosets in KgK.
For subgroups H, K of G and g in G: the set HgK; the double cosets partition G.

column1: Satake transfer of Hecke operators through a theta lift
column5: (Rallis) For an unramified dual pair of unitary/general linear groups of ranks n and n+t+1 at a split place and the vacuum datum, the Hecke polynomial of the larger group applied to a lift equals a polynomial factor R(U) (product of 1 - q^k z^n chi U, k <= t) times the lift of the Hecke polynomial of the smaller group at a rescaled variable. Form used: New.hecke_transfer_of_pairing.
column6: Hecke algebra; Theta lift; Satake isomorphism

column5: On Q_p and its extensions (in particular C_p): the absolute value normalised by |p| = 1/p; it is ultrametric: |x+y| <= max(|x|,|y|).
A generator of the maximal ideal of a discrete valuation ring; an element of valuation 1.
For a finite place l of a number field E: the subring of E of elements of non-negative valuation at l, the localisation of O_E at l.
column6: Valuation on a field; Place of a global field

column5: Over a valuation ring O with a fixed element p: a submodule N of M has colength dividing z if every finite family in M is carried into N by a square matrix over O whose determinant divides z (no bases and no inclusion assumed). For lattices N in M over a discrete valuation ring this says length(M/N) <= v(z).
A matrix over a principal ideal (or valuation) domain is equivalent to a diagonal matrix; the diagonal entries are the elementary divisors.

column1: Central idempotent of a group algebra
column5: An idempotent e in the centre of C[G] for a finite group G; |G| e(t) is the value at t^-1 of the character of the representation e C[G] divided appropriately; in particular |G| e(t) is an algebraic integer and |e(t)| <= 1.
column6: Group algebra; Character of a representation

column5: For a number field E of degree n: |disc(E)|^(1/n).

For a nonzero element x of a number field, the product of the normalised absolute values of x over all places is 1. Used in the form of heights: divisibility at all primes and sizes at all conjugates combine.
column6: Place of a global field; Absolute value

column5: A ring automorphism sigma of C (not necessarily continuous); Aut(C) acts on algebraic numbers through the absolute Galois group of Q. Sizes are bounded at every conjugate sigma(phi(g)).

The functor attached to a Young diagram sending a module V to the corresponding Weyl module; a matrix z induces the Schur matrix schur(z), multiplicative in z and with integer polynomial entries in the entries of z; for a one-row diagram it is the symmetric power.
